instruction: Resize picture's height to 18cm on slide 4.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing picture height on slide 4 only. Verified by checking: Slide 4 (index 3) shape 3 height = 18cm (originally 28.57cm). Uses 0.5% tolerance. Shape type is verified to ensure it is a picture.
metadata.verification_method: Direct dimension check using python-pptx library with 0.5% tolerance and shape type verification to ensure the shape is a picture
metadata.scoring: Binary 1.0 if all dimension checks pass and shape is verified to be a picture, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies shape type to ensure it is a picture (MSO_SHAPE_TYPE.PICTURE or has image attribute)

Proper error handling with try-except returning 0.0 on failures
